calculators.title_en: Finland Gross to Net Salary & Employer Cost Calculator
calculators.description_native: Laskee nettopalkkasi Suomessa vuodelle 2026 valtion tuloveron, kunnallisveron, kirkkoveron, Yle-veron ja lakisääteisten sosiaalivakuutusmaksujen jälkeen, sekä työnantajan kokonaiskustannukset (palkan sivukulut).

inputs.name: fringe_benefits
inputs.label_native: Luontoisedut (€ / kk - auto-, puhelin- tai ravintoetu)

calculators.formula_explanation: Taxable gross income = Monthly Gross Salary + Fringe Benefits. Employee mandatory social insurance deductions include TyEL pension contribution (7.15% for ages 17–52 and 63–67, or 8.65% for ages 53–62), Unemployment Insurance (työttömyysvakuutusmaksu: 0.79%), and Daily Allowance contribution (sairaanhoitomaksu: ~1.01%). Earned income tax is calculated by summing State Income Tax (valtion tulovero 2026 progressive brackets: 0% up to €22,000, 12.64% €22,000–€32,600, 19.00% €32,600–€40,100, 30.25% €40,100–€52,100, 33.25% €52,100–€84,000, 37.50% above €84,000), Municipal Tax (kunnallisvero: municipality rate applied after perusvähennys and työtulovähennys), Church Tax (kirkkovero: 1.0%–2.1% if applicable), and Yle Tax (2.5% on earned income above €14,000, max €163/year). Net Salary = Gross Salary - TyEL - Unemployment Insurance - Sairaanhoitomaksu - Income Taxes. Total Employer Cost = Gross Salary + Employer TyEL (~17.34%) + Employer Unemployment (~0.27%–1.09%) + Group Life Insurance (~0.06%) + Accident Insurance (~0.50%) + Social Security Fee (sotumu: ~1.43%), totaling an additional ~20%–24% on top of gross salary.

calculators.title_native: Yritysmuotolaskuri – Toiminimi vs Osakeyhtiö vs Kevytyrittäjä 2026
calculators.title_en: Finland Sole Proprietorship vs Oy vs Light Entrepreneur Tax Calculator
calculators.description_native: Vertaa käteen jäävää tuloa toiminimen (Tmi), osakeyhtiön (Oy) ja kevytyrittäjyyden välillä Suomessa 2026 ottaen huomioon 5,5 % yrittäjävähennyksen, YEL-maksun (24,4 %), yhteisöveron (20 %) ja huojennetut osingot.
calculators.formula_explanation: Net Business Profit = Revenue - Expenses. For Toiminimi (Private Trader): Mandatory YEL pension contribution is 24.40% (or 19.032% for first-time entrepreneurs) of declared YEL work income (minimum threshold €9,423.09/yr). Taxable business profit is profit minus YEL. In 2026, Entrepreneur Deduction (yrittäjävähennys) reduces taxable profit by 5.5%. The remaining 94.5% is taxed as personal earned income (ansiotulo) and capital income (pääomatulo: 20% of net assets taxed at 30%/34%). For Osakeyhtiö (Oy): Company pays 20% Corporate Tax (yhteisövero) on net profit after deducting director salary and YEL. Net profit after tax can be distributed as dividends. Low-taxed dividend (huojennettu osinko) up to 8% of company net assets is 25% taxable capital income (effective tax rate 7.5%–8.5% up to €150,000 per owner). For Kevytyrittäjä (Light Entrepreneur): Invoicing service charges a 3%–5% service fee on gross invoice amount, and remaining funds are paid as personal salary subject to YEL (if income exceeds threshold) and progressive withholding tax.

calculators.title_en: Finland Real Estate Transfer Tax & Mortgage Calculator
calculators.description_native: Laskee asunto-osakkeen (1,5 %) tai kiinteistön (3,0 %) varainsiirtoveron Suomessa sekä asuntolainan kuukausierän, korkokulut ja varainsiirtoveron eräpäivän.
calculators.formula_explanation: Debt-Free Purchase Price (velaton kauppahinta) = Purchase Price + Housing Company Debt. Transfer Tax (Varainsiirtovero) rates in Finland (updated 2024–2026): 1.5% for housing company shares (asunto-osakkeet) calculated on debt-free price, and 3.0% for real estate property (kiinteistöt) calculated on purchase price. Note: First-time homebuyer tax exemption (ensiasunnon verovapaus) was abolished; all buyers pay standard transfer tax. Additional property fees include Public Notary (kaupanvahvistaja) fee of €128–€140 and title registration (lainhuuto) fee (~€161) for real estate. Mortgage Loan Principal = Debt-Free Price - Down Payment + Transfer Tax (if financed). Monthly Payment is computed using standard annuity formula M = P * [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1]. Due date for transfer tax is 2 months from deed signing for housing shares or at registration for real estate.

calculators.description_native: Laskee pääomatuloveron Suomessa sijoitusvoitoista (30 % / 34 %), vuokratulosta (vähennyksineen), pörssiosingoista ja listaamattoman yhtiön huojennetuista osingoista.

inputs.name: acquisition_cost_or_expenses
inputs.label_native: Hankintameno / Vuokrauksen kulut (€ - hoitovastike, korot, remontit)

calculators.formula_explanation: Capital Income Tax (Pääomatulovero) scale: 30% for taxable capital income up to €30,000/year, and 34% for the portion exceeding €30,000. Capital Gain (Luovutusvoitto): Taxable Gain = Sale Price - Max(Actual Acquisition Cost + Selling Costs, Presumed Acquisition Cost / Hankintaolettama of 20% if held under 10 years, or 40% if held 10+ years). Rental Income (Vuokratulo): Net Taxable Rental Income = Gross Rent - Hoitovastike - Deductible Repair Costs - Mortgage Interest. Listed Dividend (Pörssiosinko): 85% of dividend is taxable capital income (taxed at 30%/34%), 15% is tax-free (effective tax rate 25.5% or 28.9%). Non-Listed Dividend (Listaamaton osinko): Huojennettu osinko (≤ 8% of net assets): 25% taxable capital income (effective rate 7.5% or 8.5%) up to €150,000 limit; above €150,000, 85% is taxable capital income.

calculators.title_en: Finland Earnings-Related Unemployment Benefit & Notice Period Calculator
calculators.description_native: Laskee Työsopimuslain mukaisen irtisanomisajan palkan sekä Työttömyyskassan ansiosidonnaisen päivärahan määrän vuoden 2026 porrastuksen (-20 % / -25 %) mukaisesti.
calculators.formula_explanation: Statutory Notice Period (Työsopimuslaki 6 luku 3 §): When employer terminates: under 1 year tenure = 14 days; 1–4 years = 1 month; 4–8 years = 2 months; 8–12 years = 4 months; over 12 years = 6 months. When employee resigns: up to 5 years tenure = 14 days; over 5 years = 1 month. Notice Period Salary = (Monthly Gross Salary / 21.5) * Working Days in Notice Period. Earnings-Related Unemployment Allowance (Ansiosidonnainen päiväraha): Daily Wage Base = Monthly Gross * 0.95 / 21.5. Basic Daily Allowance (peruspäiväraha) = €37.21/day. Full Allowance = Basic Allowance + 0.45 * (Daily Base - Basic Allowance) for daily wages up to €164.42/day (€3,534.95/mo), plus 0.20 * (Daily Base - €164.42) for surplus. Staggering (Porrastus 2024–2026): Days 1–40 = 100% of calculated allowance; Days 41–170 = 80% (-20% reduction); Days 171+ = 75% (-25% reduction). Paid 5 days per week.
